text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Adoption followed trust. Reps used it once we promised summaries wouldn't be used for surveillance.

2. CRM updates dropped from 25 minutes to under 10 per day. That time went back to prospects.

3. The best gain was follow-up speed. Emails now go out within an hour, not the next morning.

4. Accuracy slipped on noisy sites and heavy jargon. Reps still review before saving.

5. Managers got better coaching material, but only after we agreed on what to look for.

The tool didn't change how we sell. It removed the admin that kept reps from selling.

Next quarter: expanding to two more regions.

What would you want from a pilot like this?
